notes: §1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR4 makes the unique data item begin at leftmost-character-position ("must result in a positive nonzero integer less than or equal to the number of characters in the data item"), run for length ("The evaluation of length must result in a positive nonzero integer", with position + length - 1 within the item) and, "If length is not specified", extend to "the rightmost character of the data item"; Amendment 1 adds a function result as the operand. No edition arm computes it: RefModBinder.ReadRefMod binds both positions, RefModView builds the RefModPlace over the item's character image (IntrinsicBinder.ResultRefMod reads the same modifier for FUNCTION f (args) (p:l)), and the runtime CobolString.RefMod / SpliceInto take the 1-based slice, the omitted length running to the end. The 1985 difference is the zero length: allowZeroLength is set only by >>REF-MOD-ZERO-LENGTH, which the construct registry row ref-mod-zero-length-2023 refuses at --std 85 (COBOL0900, probed), so RefModOutOfRange holds length to nonzero at 85. A violation, for which 1985 states no result, is refused at compile time when the positions are literals (LiteralRefModRangeViolation, COBOL2670) and ends the run unit otherwise. The witness slices a PIC X item and an UPPER-CASE result with literal and expression positions, with and without length, as sender and receiver; a probe added a group, numeric DISPLAY, SIGN SEPARATE, numeric-edited and subscripted operands, all positioned correctly at --std 85.

next.reason: Amendment 1 (X3.23a-1989) only added the function operand: 'the data item referenced by data-name-1 or by function-name-1 and its arguments, if any' (§1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR4); 2023's identifier-1 covers both, so that part is carried. The change is in the length. 1985: 'The evaluation of length must result in a positive nonzero integer' (§1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR4). 2023: 'The evaluation of length shall result in a positive nonzero integer, unless the REF-MOD-ZERO-LENGTH directive is set to ON, when the result may also be zero' (§2023:8.4.3.3.4 GR5), a restriction lifted; and a violation is now an exception condition: for a non-integer, zero or out-of-range position or length 'the EC-BOUND-REF-MOD exception condition is set to exist' (§2023:8.4.3.3.4 GR5), and with the directive omitted or off a zero-length result means 'the exception condition EC-BOUND-REF-MOD is raised' (§2023:7.3.23.3 GR1). GR5 a) also adds bit positions ('If the usage of identifier-1 is bit, positions used in evaluation are bit positions', §2023:8.4.3.3.4 GR5). Leftmost position, the sum rule and the omitted length are otherwise the same.
